description:
Create a custom emoji in a server. The bot needs CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - name (string): Emoji name (2-32 chars, alphanumeric and underscores)
  - image_url (string): URL of image (PNG, JPG, GIF under 256KB)
  - roles (string[], optional): Role IDs that can use this emoji

Returns:
  Created emoji details

image_url.description: URL of the image to use for the emoji

name: discord_create_emoji
title: Create Emoji
